mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fin_ex_wb_task_t(task_id,tenant_id,owner_user_id,caller_id,create_request_id,create_hash,create_ack_json,responsible_agent_id,assignment_version,task_version,status,source_app_id,l1_key,l1_name,l2_key,l3_key,title,snapshot_json) VALUES(#{taskId},#{tenant},#{owner},#{caller},#{requestId},#{hash},#{ack},#{agent},1,1,#{status},#{app},#{l1},#{l1Name},#{l2},#{l3},#{title},#{json}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE create_hash=fin_ex_wb_task_t.create_hash
mapper.select: SELECT task_id,create_hash,create_ack_json FROM fin_ex_wb_task_t WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND caller_id=#{caller} AND create_request_id=#{requestId}
SELECT snapshot_json FROM fin_ex_wb_task_t WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
SELECT snapshot_json FROM fin_ex_wb_task_t WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR SHARE
mapper.update: UPDATE fin_ex_wb_task_t SET responsible_agent_id=#{agent},assignment_version=#{assignment},task_version=#{version},status=#{status},title=#{title},snapshot_json=#{json},last_update_date=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND task_version=#{previous}
UPDATE fin_ex_wb_task_t SET deleted_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND status IN ('COMPLETED','TERMINATED') AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM fin_ex_chat_session_t WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND user_id=#{user} AND id=#{session} AND status!='DELETED' FOR UPDATE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM fin_ex_wb_task_session_t WHERE session_id=#{session} AND user_id=#{user} AND task_id IN (SELECT task_id FROM fin_ex_wb_task_t WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fin_ex_wb_task_member_t WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND user_id=#{user}
SELECT ack_json,payload_hash FROM fin_ex_wb_task_event_t WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND caller_id=#{caller} AND source_event_id=#{eventId}
SELECT task_version,changes_json FROM fin_ex_wb_task_event_t WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND task_version > #{cursor} ORDER BY task_version LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fin_ex_wb_task_group_t(task_id,group_id,sort_order,removed,snapshot_json) VALUES(#{taskId},#{id},#{sort},#{removed},#{json}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE sort_order=EXCLUDED.sort_order,removed=EXCLUDED.removed,snapshot_json=EXCLUDED.snapshot_json,last_update_date=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT snapshot_json FROM fin_ex_wb_task_group_t WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND group_id=#{id}
SELECT snapshot_json FROM fin_ex_wb_task_group_t WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND removed=false ORDER BY sort_order,group_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fin_ex_wb_task_step_t(task_id,step_id,sort_order,removed,snapshot_json,group_id,status,step_version) VALUES(#{taskId},#{id},#{sort},#{removed},#{json},#{group},#{status},#{version}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE sort_order=EXCLUDED.sort_order,removed=EXCLUDED.removed,snapshot_json=EXCLUDED.snapshot_json,group_id=EXCLUDED.group_id,status=EXCLUDED.status,step_version=EXCLUDED.step_version,last_update_date=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT snapshot_json FROM fin_ex_wb_task_step_t WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND step_id=#{id}
SELECT snapshot_json FROM fin_ex_wb_task_step_t WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND removed=false ORDER BY sort_order,step_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fin_ex_wb_task_step_t WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND group_id=#{id} AND removed=false

SELECT audit_id,actor_id,actor_type,object_id,action_type,outcome,creation_date FROM fin_ex_wb_task_audit_t WHERE task_id=#{taskId} ORDER BY creation_date DESC,audit_id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT session_id FROM fin_ex_wb_task_session_t WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND user_id=#{user}
SELECT s.task_id FROM fin_ex_wb_task_session_t s JOIN fin_ex_wb_task_t t ON t.task_id=s.task_id WHERE s.session_id=#{session} AND s.user_id=#{user} AND t.tenant_id=#{tenant}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM fin_ex_wb_task_session_t WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND user_id=#{user}
mapper.select: SELECT agent_id,status,request_json,answer_json FROM fin_ex_wb_task_interaction_t WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND interaction_id=#{id}
SELECT status,request_json,answer_json FROM fin_ex_wb_task_interaction_t WHERE task_id=#{taskId} ORDER BY creation_date,interaction_id
mapper.update: UPDATE fin_ex_wb_task_interaction_t SET status='ANSWERED',answer_json=#{json},answered_by=#{user},last_update_date=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND interaction_id=#{id} AND status='WAITING' AND assignment_version=#{assignment}
UPDATE fin_ex_wb_task_interaction_t SET status='CANCELLED',last_update_date=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND status='WAITING'
mapper.select: SELECT command_id,payload_hash,delivery_status FROM fin_ex_wb_task_command_t WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND actor_id=#{user} AND idem_key=#{key}
SELECT command_id FROM fin_ex_wb_task_command_t WHERE delivery_status IN ('PENDING','IN_FLIGHT') AND next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY next_attempt_at LIMIT 16
mapper.update: UPDATE fin_ex_wb_task_command_t SET lease_token=#{lease},delivery_status='IN_FLIGHT',attempt_count=attempt_count+1,next_attempt_at=#{until} WHERE command_id=#{id} AND next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND delivery_status IN ('PENDING','IN_FLIGHT')
mapper.select: SELECT c.agent_id,c.assignment_version,c.attempt_count,c.payload_json,t.tenant_id,t.source_app_id,t.status AS task_status,t.assignment_version AS current_assignment,t.deleted_at FROM fin_ex_wb_task_command_t c JOIN fin_ex_wb_task_t t ON c.task_id=t.task_id WHERE command_id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE fin_ex_wb_task_command_t SET delivery_status=#{status},next_attempt_at=#{next},lease_token=NULL,last_update_date=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE command_id=#{id} AND lease_token=#{lease}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fin_ex_wb_task_output_stream_t(task_id,scope_key,last_output_seq) VALUES(#{taskId},#{scope},0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_output_seq=fin_ex_wb_task_output_stream_t.last_output_seq
mapper.select: SELECT last_output_seq FROM fin_ex_wb_task_output_stream_t WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND scope_key=#{scope} FOR UPDATE
SELECT last_output_seq FROM fin_ex_wb_task_output_stream_t WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND scope_key=#{scope}
mapper.update: UPDATE fin_ex_wb_task_output_stream_t SET last_output_seq=#{seq}, last_update_date=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND scope_key=#{scope}
mapper.select: SELECT scope_key,agent_id,status,assignment_version,last_frame_no,checkpoint_json FROM fin_ex_wb_task_operation_t WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND operation_id=#{operation} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fin_ex_wb_task_operation_t(task_id,scope_key,operation_id,agent_id,assignment_version,last_frame_no,status,content,checkpoint_json) VALUES(#{taskId},#{scope},#{operation},#{agent},#{assignment},#{last},#{status},#{content},#{checkpoint}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_frame_no=EXCLUDED.last_frame_no,status=EXCLUDED.status,content=EXCLUDED.content,checkpoint_json=EXCLUDED.checkpoint_json,last_update_date=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT operation_id,agent_id,status,content FROM fin_ex_wb_task_operation_t WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND scope_key=#{scope} ORDER BY creation_date,operation_id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fin_ex_wb_task_op_part_t(task_id,operation_id,part_order,part_json) VALUES(#{taskId},#{operation},#{ord},#{json}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE part_json=EXCLUDED.part_json,last_update_date=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT payload_hash,last_frame_no,last_output_seq FROM fin_ex_wb_task_output_frame_t WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND operation_id=#{operation} AND first_frame_no=#{first}

SELECT events_json FROM fin_ex_wb_task_output_frame_t WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND scope_key=#{scope} AND last_output_seq > #{cursor} AND last_output_seq >= first_output_seq AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY first_output_seq,first_frame_no LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM fin_ex_wb_task_output_frame_t WHERE (task_id,operation_id,first_frame_no) IN (SELECT task_id,operation_id,first_frame_no FROM fin_ex_wb_task_output_frame_t WHERE expires_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY expires_at LIMIT 256)
mapper.select: SELECT definition_json,schema_version FROM fin_ex_wb_task_schema_t WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND app_id=#{app} AND category_key=#{category} AND schema_version=#{version} ORDER BY creation_date DESC,schema_version DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fin_ex_wb_task_operation_t(task_id,scope_key,operation_id,agent_id,assignment_version,last_frame_no,status,content,checkpoint_json) VALUES(#{taskId},#{scope},#{operation},#{agent},#{assignment},0,'RUNNING',NULL,'{}') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_frame_no=fin_ex_wb_task_operation_t.last_frame_no
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total,COUNT(CASE WHEN status='COMPLETED' THEN 1 END) AS completed FROM fin_ex_wb_task_step_t WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND removed=false
